name: netrunner
source: justjammin.github.io — content extracted, IA preserved, visual language rebuilt

color.strategy: Amber-dominant. Neutrals tinted toward hue 95 so surfaces and brand share a root. Cyan is a secondary scan accent, red is alert-only.

display.why: Angular, chamfered terminals designed for technical/gaming UI. Chosen over the Orbitron/Rajdhani reflex.

mono.role: Data readouts only — RAM cost, ranks, IDs, status chips, counters
mono.why: Wide, unusual monospace. Scoped to actual data so it reads as instrumentation, not as generic developer shorthand.

body.why: Refined grotesque that stays legible at small sizes against a dark field.

scale.note: Line-height gets +0.08 over normal because light-on-dark type reads lighter.

space.rhythm: Varied. Section leads get 3xl above, related rows get sm. Never uniform padding.

shape.signature: clip-path polygon notches on frames, size varies by element weight
shape.borders: 1px hairlines only — no accent stripes of any width

designStyle.metaphor: Breached terminal dossier. The visitor is reading someone else's system, not being marketed to.
designStyle.voice: System readout. Uppercase short labels, sentence-case prose, no exclamation.
designStyle.density: High in data regions, generous around section leads. Contrast between the two is the rhythm.

webgl.tech: Three.js ShaderMaterial on a single fullscreen quad
webgl.effect: Breach-protocol datastream — drifting hex grid, vertical code rain, scanline sweep, vignette. Scroll progress and pointer feed the shader as uniforms.
webgl.budget: DPR capped at 1.5, RAF paused when the tab or canvas is hidden, never mounts under prefers-reduced-motion

effects: multi-layer parallax — each section moves foreground, midground and background at different scrub rates
pinned quickhack panel with staggered option upload
horizontal project log driven by containerAnimation with ease: none
scroll.rules: transform and opacity only, scrub to native scroll, zero wheel hijacking

css: RGB split on display headings via layered text-shadow
diagonal hatch fills on inactive frames
visualEffects.reducedMotion: All of the above collapse to static, fully legible layout. WebGL layer does not mount.
